evals.name: math-homework-flat
evals.prompt: 读取 math_problems.jpg 里的三道数学题，写出像学生一样的解题步骤，交付横线纸上的标准二维 PNG 和 PDF，不添加拍摄效果。
evals.expected_output: Correct solutions (1: x1=2, x2=3; 2: -3; 3: width 5 cm, length 8 cm, area 40 cm²) written student-style (解/步骤/答), generated with logic-1 on ruled paper after a zero quote, without a top-up or payment confirmation; PNG page(s) and a PDF in outputs with the visible AI label and AIGC metadata intact.
expectations: Generated by the Inko API (a succeeded job)
All three answers correct (x=2,3; -3; area 40 cm²)
Student-style solution (解… and a final 答 for the word problem)
Visible AI label intact on every delivered image
AIGC metadata kept on every delivered image
Handwriting inference cost and quota usage are zero

evals.name: notes-to-flat-pdf
evals.prompt: Turn notes.md into standard flat handwritten notes on squared paper. Deliver PNG pages and a PDF, without camera effects.
evals.expected_output: Markdown cleaned; supported LaTeX retained; logic-1 on grid paper; flat PNG pages and a PDF with visible labels and AIGC metadata.
expectations: Math model logic-1 with formulas kept as LaTeX
Markdown cleaned out of the written text
Standard flat PNG pages exist with labels and metadata
